verdict.rationale: Perplexity ships a named Deep Research mode for 'deeper exploration' (perplexity-docs-8, perplexity-docs-27), claims cited sources for every answer (perplexity-docs-12), and offers Labs for producing reports (perplexity-docs-10). The evidence describes the feature only briefly. One hands-on user reports citations frequently mismatched to the text (perplexity-comm-6), which lowers quality but does not concretely contradict the feature's existence. missing for 10: detailed documentation of Deep Research's autonomous multi-source search behavior and report format, independent hands-on corroboration that Deep Research runs complete and produce reliably cited reports.
